attacks.title: Forced overcurrent + temperature spoof
attacks.mitre: T0836 Modify Parameter + T0856 Spoof Reporting
attacks.description: The charge current is forced to 250 A while the temperature sensor is pinned to a safe-looking 30 °C, so the BMS never derates and the pack cooks. Real peak 57.7 °C; with the proxy on, 43.2 °C.

attacks.title: Thermal-sensor drift
attacks.description: The reported temperature slides 0.01 °C lower every second — no single reading looks wrong, but the gap from reality keeps widening while current is pushed up. Real peak 49.5 °C; with the proxy on, 43.2 °C.

attacks.title: Sensor replay / stale freeze
attacks.description: The last good telemetry frame is replayed forever, so the gauge freezes while real current keeps heating the pack behind it. Real peak 52.6 °C; with the proxy on, 43.2 °C.

attacks.title: False-data synthesis
attacks.description: A fabricated temperature curve that rises exactly as Joule heating predicts, just 15 °C below reality — built to pass rate checks, so the absolute physics model has to catch it. Real peak 54.2 °C; with the proxy on, 43.2 °C.

attacks.title: Mass max-power broadcast
attacks.description: One forged command drives all 12 chargers in the hub to full power at once, overloading the shared transformer to 174% and sagging the bus 8.7%. The Zero-Trust proxy refuses it and holds the load to 104%.
